ahrc.definition: A person, thing, or idea present or near in place, time, or thought or just mentioned. As prominent or pointed out.
To move toward something; approach; enter. This can be understood as to come or to go.
Used as a function word to indicate movement or an action or condition suggestive of progress toward a place, person, or thing reached.
